hebrewText: וְ/גַ֣ם אָנֹכִי֩ מָנַ֨עְתִּי מִ/כֶּ֜ם אֶת הַ/גֶּ֗שֶׁם בְּ/ע֨וֹד שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה חֳדָשִׁים֙ לַ/קָּצִ֔יר וְ/הִמְטַרְתִּי֙ עַל עִ֣יר אֶחָ֔ת וְ/עַל עִ֥יר אַחַ֖ת לֹ֣א אַמְטִ֑יר חֶלְקָ֤ה אַחַת֙ תִּמָּטֵ֔ר וְ/חֶלְקָ֛ה אֲשֶֽׁר לֹֽא תַמְטִ֥יר עָלֶ֖י/הָ תִּיבָֽשׁ

tokens.bdb: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
tokens.kjv: again, alike, also, (so much) as (soon), both (so)...and, but, either...or, even, for all, (in) likewise (manner), moreover, nay...neither, one, then(-refore), though, what, with, yea.

tokens.bdb: I
tokens.kjv: I, me, [idiom] which.

tokens.kjv: deny, keep (back), refrain, restrain, withhold.

tokens.explanation: to debar  from benefit or injury

tokens.bdb: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.kjv: rain, shower.

tokens.bdb: three; occasionally (ordinal) third, or (multiple) thrice
tokens.kjv: [phrase] fork, [phrase] often(-times), third, thir(-teen, -teenth), three, [phrase] thrice. Compare H7991 (שָׁלִישׁ).

tokens.bdb: the new moon; by implication, a month
tokens.kjv: month(-ly), new moon.

tokens.bdb: severed, i.e. harvest (as reaped), the crop, the time, the reaper, or figuratively; also a limb (of a tree, or simply foliage)
tokens.kjv: bough, branch, harvest (man).

tokens.bdb: to rain
tokens.kjv: (cause to) rain (upon).

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
